# PublishRank SEO for WordPress
> PublishRank SEO 2.26.2 is a free, open-source WordPress SEO plugin for businesses, stores, service providers, creators, publishers and websites of every kind. The release adds a unified Classic Editor dock, Media tab and image licence metadata, expanded search/social preview simulations, and a publishrank/v1 REST API; it also tightens SEO-edit permissions, public REST editorial data and analytics collection limits. The included report records WordPress 7.1.5 with SQLite, PHP 8.3 and Chromium/Playwright checks, and lists environments and checks not performed. It does not claim every supported minimum runtime was tested.
